extraction.policy_summary: Ashok Leyland states it upholds a policy of equal opportunity in compliance with the RPwD Act, 2016, embedded through its Code of Conduct for executives (non-discrimination including on disability) and an 'Affirmative-Action Policy' extending equal employment opportunity to candidates from disadvantaged backgrounds who meet requisite skills/qualifications.
extraction.accommodation_process_summary: The Company states facilities are 'designed or adapted to meet diverse needs and reasonable accommodations provided on a case-by-case basis,' supported by 'detailed feasibility assessments to identify and address the specific needs of persons with disabilities at each location.' No defined response-time commitment is given.
extraction.pwd_employee_count_details: Differently abled Employees: 6 permanent (5 male, 83.33%; 1 female, 16.67%), 0 other-than-permanent, total 6. Differently abled Workers: 47 permanent (47 male, 100%; 0 female), 0 other-than-permanent, total 47. Against a total workforce of 5,807 employees and 30,291 workers.
extraction.physical_accessibility_measures: 'Proactive infrastructure enhancements have been implemented to address mobility and accessibility requirements' across offices and manufacturing plants, with facilities 'designed or adapted to meet diverse needs.' Facilities are also stated to be 'designed and equipped to accommodate visitors with disabilities.' No specific features (ramps, restrooms, elevators) are itemised.
extraction.culture_practices_details: 'Ashok Leyland actively seeks feedback from employees, workers, and visitors to continually strengthen accessibility measures, supported by detailed feasibility assessments to identify and address the specific needs of persons with disabilities at each location.' This is described as an ongoing practice rather than a one-time policy statement, though no ERG, flexible-work option, or response-time commitment is named.
extraction.compliance_details: Filing answers the mandated BRSR RPwD Act questions: 'Yes, Ashok Leyland ensures that its premises and offices are accessible to persons with disabilities, in compliance with the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016,' and confirms an equal opportunity policy per the RPwD Act via its Code of Conduct. No statutory employment quota attainment percentage or WCAG conformance level is stated.
